'''Eric Heinig''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[2001 MegaCon tournament]] on 3 March 2001, according to Neal Razi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1851">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-07-dredlox-neal-at-megacon-march-3-2001d1851/ dredlox-neal-at-megacon-march-3-2001], DeckTech (Neal "Dredlox" Razi, 7 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-07-dredlox-neal-at-megacon-march-3-2001d1851/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
